description: A dark, painterly interior lit by a single desk lamp. In the center is a beige office machine, a keyboard-and-carriage unit with a long strip of perforated paper that spills onto the floor in folds. Behind it are a reel-to-reel tape recorder and a stack of reels, and at left are shelves of small cards or folders. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible border.
